column3: BSB’s “Jesus” matches the Textus Receptus (Ἰησοῦς); the critical text has no name.
“Got up” and “laid aside” render presents; “outer” specifies garments.
“Came” and “asked” render presents; are going to wash replaces wash.
“Jesus” supplies the subject; put on replaces took.
“Shares My bread” renders eats My bread.
“At His side” replaces in Jesus’ bosom.
The verbal instruction is reduced to a gesture.
“Against Jesus” renders upon Jesus’ breast; asked renders says.
“Gave” renders gives; BSB lacks “takes,” as does the Textus Receptus (λαμβάνει).
“When Judas had taken” expands after the morsel; about to do replaces do.
“Into the night” replaces the separate statement it was night.
